The '''Sphere of Defense of the Empire''', also known as the '''Ministry of Defense''' and the '''Pyramid of Defense''', was one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Ruled by a member of the [[Dark Council]], the Sphere oversaw the use of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] in the defense of the Empire, sharing joint control of the military with the [[Sphere of Military Offense|Spheres of Military Offense]] and [[Sphere of Military Strategy|Military Strategy]]. [[Darth Marr]] was the head of the Sphere throughout the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the Spheres of Military Offense and Military Strategy into the [[Sphere of Military Command]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
